message.reasoning_content:
We need to read the fact: The defendant used his position as deputy director and researcher in Hunan Provincial Science and Technology Department to obtain benefits for others in applying for national innovation fund projects, and demanded or accepted cash from Wang, Chen, Li totaling RMB 279,417. This is abuse of power for personal gain, i.e., "受贿" (accepting bribes). Also possibly "滥用职权" (abuse of power) but the core is bribery. The fact says he "索取或收受...现金共计人民币27.9417万". That's bribery. Under Chinese criminal law, the crime is "受贿罪". Also could be "为他人谋取利益" is "行贿" but the defendant is the recipient, so "受贿". Also "利用职务上的便利为他人谋取利益" is typical for "受贿". So only one crime: 受贿罪.

Thus answer: [罪名]受贿<eoa>
